task: In the Hugging Face documentation, find the tutorial on loading adapters with PEFT, tell me how to load in 8bit or 4bit.
answer: In the Hugging Face PEFT adapter-loading tutorial (https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/peft), to load an adapter in 8bit or 4bit you use bitsandbytes quantization: create a BitsAndBytesConfig with load_in_8bit=True for 8-bit (or load_in_4bit=True for 4-bit, optionally with bnb_4bit_quant_type="nf4") and pass it as quantization_config to AutoPeftModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained / PeftModel.from_pretrained together with device_map="auto". Example (8bit): quantization_config = BitsAndBytesConfig(load_in_8bit=True); model = AutoPeftModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("peft_adapter_path", quantization_config=quantization_config, device_map="auto").
